prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Clear Account Sync Warning on Sign In: Redesign the sign-in screen to feature account synchronization assurances and auto-recovery options for previous pet profiles. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drop-off is 27.1%.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Control Guide Screen: Insert a dedicated desktop control tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates how to drag, summon, hide, and talk to the pet. (why: Users submitted 3 support tickets confused about how to control, hide or talk to their pet, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Split View Path Selection Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into side-by-side comparative cards with time estimates and clear feature descriptions. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite median 8s, showing significant user hesitation during path choice.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Desktop Spawn Tips on Waiting Screen: Add an engaging carousel of desktop placement tips and expected behavior notices to the generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen has a high mean time of 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on the desktop.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines and Sample Hints: Add visible guidelines and bad/good photo examples below the upload box to assist custom pet generation. (why: 3 users emailed support due to failed pet generations or strange-looking custom results.)
5: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Summary Copy: Update the home intro text to prominently detail hotkeys and desktop tray controls. (why: Multiple support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding, summoning, or chatting with the desktop pet.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Status & Diagnostic Banner: Display an active connection status badge and retry trigger on the sign in screen to prevent blank screen stalls. (why: 2 support emails report the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly.)
